qualities.label: Strength
qualities.description: Heavy loads, low reps, full recovery between efforts; the goal is force production.

qualities.label: Power
qualities.description: Fast, explosive efforts (olympic lifts, jumps, speed work) at moderate-to-heavy load with full recovery.

qualities.label: Skill
qualities.description: Technique practice in gymnastics or lifting at low fatigue; movement quality over output.

qualities.label: Conditioning
qualities.description: Metabolic work against the clock (AMRAP, for time, intervals, EMOM sprints); the goal is sustained output.

qualities.label: Muscular endurance
qualities.description: High-rep sets at light-to-moderate load, not primarily against the clock (accessory work, volume sets).

qualities.label: Preparation
qualities.description: Warm-up, mobility, activation or cool-down; low intensity by design.

energySystems.label: Phosphagen
energySystems.description: Maximal efforts under ~15 s with long rests: heavy singles, sprints, max jumps.

energySystems.label: Glycolytic
energySystems.description: Hard efforts from ~30 s to a few minutes, or short workouts near redline (roughly 2-8 min).

energySystems.label: Oxidative
energySystems.description: Sustainable, paced efforts: long workouts and steady intervals (roughly over 8 min).

loadIntensities.label: Light
loadIntensities.description: Below ~60% of 1RM, or bodyweight movements the athlete can cycle unbroken.

loadIntensities.label: Moderate
loadIntensities.description: Roughly 60-80% of 1RM; sets need some breaking for most athletes.

loadIntensities.label: Heavy
loadIntensities.description: Above ~80% of 1RM; low reps, form is the limiter.
